messages:
maria.docs: Quick heads-up — the Quickstart README Python snippet uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN but our SDK/CLI expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. Multiple users hit 401s after copy/paste. Also the `requests` example has no retry guidance.

aj.devex: Oh no. Can you paste the exact snippet you saw?

maria.docs: Sure — it looked like this in the README:```python
import os
import requests

url = 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'
token = os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_TOKEN')
resp = requests.post(url, json={"prompt":"hi"}, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
print(resp.json())
```

maria.docs: That `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` var name is the mismatch. The header pattern is fine, but we should standardize the var name and add retry guidance for transient 5xx/timeouts.

kyle.sdk: We actually soft-support both names in the SDK (REDWOOD_API_KEY preferred, then REDWOOD_TOKEN) to reduce breakage, but docs should show the canonical `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Agree on adding a tiny requests retry snippet and call out the SDK's built-in retry behavior and how to opt into it.

aj.devex: Awesome. Can you open a PR to fix the README and add the retry snippet? Also mention copying creds into example repos is a footgun.

maria.docs: Done — opened PR #4522 with the README var rename, added a small `requests` retry adapter example, and a one-liner note about not committing tokens. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4522

kyle.sdk: Nice. For the retry example, use urllib3 Retry + requests adapter. Copy for paste:```python
import os
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

session = requests.Session()
retries = Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.3, status_forcelist=(500, 502, 504))
session.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries))

url = 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'
token = os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
resp = session.post(url, json={"prompt":"hello"}, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, timeout=10)
print(resp.json())
```

kyle.sdk: Also put a short note: "If you're using Redwood SDKs, prefer the official client — it handles retries, backoff, and token refresh patterns for common languages."

aj.devex: CI preview just ran for the docs site. maria, did you include the var rename in the quickstart templates too?

maria.docs: Yup — I updated the quickstart repo and the sample app templates. CI preview passed: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-4522.

ci-bot: deploy-status: staging build 7890 passed — no broken links detected.

aj.devex: One more ask — can we backport this small change to the v1.x docs? A bunch of Dedicated customers still reference them.

kyle.sdk: I'll open a backport PR after #4522 is merged.

maria.docs: Thanks all :raised_hands: — will merge once any final comments on the retry snippet are in. Follow-up: maybe add a tiny 'common gotchas' note at the top of quickstart about env var names and token scope.

aj.devex: SGTM, thanks for catching this quickly.

maria.docs: Closing the loop here — PR updated with AJ's wording tweak and added the backport issue number in the PR description.
